'''2019 MPC Isaac Story DS I Want That Map''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Isaac Story]] at [[2019 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Isaac Story]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me|V8-D-iwantthatmap.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open I Want That Map Story DS 2019 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-match-play-championships/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2019-match-play-championships.html swccg.com snapshot], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013162035/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2019-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive]
